mod.description: Resurrect zombies on any day and as often as you like, not just once on the Day of Envy. The PR Machine works on any day too.
Enabled.name: Mod enabled
Enabled.description: Turns the mod on or off (takes effect immediately).
AnyDay.name: Resurrect on any day
AnyDay.description: Allow resurrections on every day of the week, not just on the Day of Envy.
AnyDay.hint: Not just on the Day of Envy.
UnlimitedPower.name: Unlimited storm power
UnlimitedPower.description: The power switch in the resurrection lab always has power, so you can resurrect as often as you like. Off = vanilla: the power recharges once a week at the end of the Day of Lust and is used up by a resurrection.
UnlimitedPower.hint: The lab always has power. Off = recharges once a week.
PrMachineAnyDay.name: PR Machine on any day
PrMachineAnyDay.description: Use the PR Machine on every day of the week, not just on the Day of Gluttony, so you can raise the zombie limit again as soon as the previous run has ended. A run still ends at the end of a Day of Wrath, like in vanilla: started on the Day of Wrath, its first week is over the same evening.
PrMachineAnyDay.hint: Not just on the Day of Gluttony. A run still ends on a Day of Wrath.
